innisfallen_scribe.text: Welcome to Innisfallen. Saint Finian the Leper founded a monastery on this island around 640. We keep the quiet here.
Monks wrote the Annals of Innisfallen here, a history of Ireland from the early centuries to the 1300s. The book is in Oxford now.
The island sits in Lough Leane, the biggest of the Killarney lakes. Bring a boat, or a firm belief in Brook-wade.
